## App Shows a Database Error

Initialize the MS database:

```bash
cd /srv/shiny-server/ms-app
sudo -u shiny Rscript setup_database.R
sudo systemctl restart shiny-server
```

The setup command preserves an existing database by default while applying migrations and seed checks. Do not use `MS_RESET_DB=1` as a troubleshooting step; **it deletes the target database.** If replacement is necessary, first follow [Database backup and exact recovery](deploy-operations.qmd#database-backup-and-exact-recovery).

Check ownership:

```bash
ls -l /srv/shiny-server/ms-app/ms_projects.db
sudo chown shiny:shiny /srv/shiny-server/ms-app/ms_projects.db
```

## `/ms-app/` Returns 404

Check that Shiny serves the app:

```bash
curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3838/ms-app/
```

Check Apache proxy paths in `scripts/ms-vm-shiny-443.conf`:

```apache
ProxyPass /ms-app/ http://127.0.0.1:3838/ms-app/
ProxyPassReverse /ms-app/ http://127.0.0.1:3838/ms-app/
```

Restart:

```bash
sudo apache2ctl -t
sudo systemctl restart apache2
sudo systemctl restart shiny-server
```

## LDAP Prompt Works but App Does Not Log In

This is the same failure mode documented for BCFNGS: Apache LDAP works, but
the Shiny R worker is still running with local-mode environment settings.
Do not rely only on `systemctl show shiny-server --property=Environment`;
the working BCFNGS setup uses the app-local `.Renviron`.

Confirm the app-local runtime mode:

```bash
sudo cat /srv/shiny-server/ms-app/.Renviron
```

Required:

```ini
AUTH_MODE=ldap
TRUST_PROXY_AUTH_USER_QUERY=1
```

If needed, reset it exactly:

```bash
sudo tee /srv/shiny-server/ms-app/.Renviron >/dev/null <<'EOF'
AUTH_MODE=ldap
TRUST_PROXY_AUTH_USER_QUERY=1
LDAP_URI=ldaps://ldapserv1.biochem.mpg.de,ldaps://ldapserv2.biochem.mpg.de,ldaps://ldapserv3.biochem.mpg.de
LDAP_BASE_DN=dc=biochem,dc=mpg,dc=de
LDAP_ATTR_UID=uid
LDAP_ATTR_MAIL=mail
LDAP_ATTR_PHONE=telephoneNumber
LDAP_ATTR_OU=ou
LDAP_ATTR_COST_CENTER=departmentNumber
LDAP_FACILITY_GROUPS=b_ms,b_ngs
LDAP_ATTR_CN=cn
LDAP_ATTR_GIVENNAME=givenName
LDAP_ATTR_SN=sn
MS_FACILITY_EMAIL=ms-service@biochem.mpg.de
MS_MAIL_FROM=ms-service@biochem.mpg.de
MS_POOL_FALLBACK_EMAIL=omicsdesk@biochem.mpg.de
SMTP_HOST=msx.biochem.mpg.de
SMTP_PORT=25
SMTP_SSL=0
SMTP_TLS=0
# Optional: comma-separated recipient domains, for example biochem.mpg.de.
# MS_EMAIL_ALLOWED_DOMAINS=biochem.mpg.de
MS_UPLOAD_ROOT=/fs/pool/pool-mscf-projects
MS_LOCAL_UPLOAD_FALLBACK=/srv/ms-app-data/uploads_pending_pool
MS_MAX_UPLOAD_MB=75
# Temporary: keep this only while debugging LDAP, then remove or set to 0.
LDAP_DEBUG=1
EOF
sudo chown shiny:shiny /srv/shiny-server/ms-app/.Renviron
sudo chmod 640 /srv/shiny-server/ms-app/.Renviron
sudo systemctl restart shiny-server
```

Verify that the deployed code is current:

```bash
sudo grep -n "client_url_search\\|auth-status-box\\|is_ldap_mode" /srv/shiny-server/ms-app/app.R
```

Expected: all three terms should be found. If not, redeploy the latest `ms-app/`.

Then inspect the latest Shiny log:

```bash
LATEST=$(sudo ls -1t /var/log/shiny-server/ms-app-shiny-*.log | head -n1)
sudo tail -n 120 "$LATEST"
```

Check the redirect:

```bash
curl -Ik -u USER https://mscf-vm.biochem.mpg.de/ms-app/
```

Expected: `Location: https://mscf-vm.biochem.mpg.de/ms-app/?auth_user=USER`.

## SMTP Relay Rejections

If `scripts/test.mailR.R` can send mail from the VM but the app logs `550 5.7.54 SMTP; Unable to relay recipient in non-accepted domain`, first compare the script's `from` address with `MS_MAIL_FROM` in `/srv/shiny-server/ms-app/.Renviron`. The relay must accept the app's sender address, not only the standalone test sender.

The app sends one SMTP message per recipient and logs each result separately. This means one rejected address should no longer prevent the other recipients from receiving the message. If the relay should only receive internal recipients while testing, set `MS_EMAIL_ALLOWED_DOMAINS=biochem.mpg.de` in `.Renviron`; otherwise leave it unset.

## Landing Text Still Shows Old Defaults

Routine deployment preserves `ms_projects.db`. Existing `landing_text_blocks` rows are therefore not replaced merely by changing `ms_landing_text_defaults` or running `setup_database.R`.

After deploying the updated `db_schema.R`, apply the standard defaults explicitly:

```bash
cd /srv/shiny-server/ms-app
sudo -u shiny Rscript apply_content_defaults.R
sudo systemctl restart shiny-server
```

The synchronization preserves custom landing blocks and the active/inactive state of existing standard blocks.

## Upload Pool Missing

Configured project-upload root:

```text
/fs/pool/pool-mscf-projects
```

If this path does not exist, the app stores uploads in `/srv/ms-app-data/uploads_pending_pool/` outside the deployed app directory and logs/sends a facility warning. This is intentional; project submission should not stop because the pool folder is not mounted yet.

New project folders use the pattern `YYYYMMDD_USERNAME_PROJECTID`.

Check fallback files:

```bash
sudo find /srv/ms-app-data/uploads_pending_pool -maxdepth 2 -type f
```

## Logs

```bash
sudo tail -n 120 /var/log/shiny-server/ms-app-shiny-*.log
```

To take a look only at the latest one:

```bash
LATEST=$(sudo ls -1t /var/log/shiny-server/ms-app-shiny-*.log | head -n1)
sudo tail -n 120 "$LATEST"
```

## Local Maintenance Mode

```bash
sudo sed -i 's/^AUTH_MODE=.*/AUTH_MODE=local/' /srv/shiny-server/ms-app/.Renviron
sudo systemctl restart shiny-server
```

Return to LDAP:

```bash
sudo sed -i 's/^AUTH_MODE=.*/AUTH_MODE=ldap/' /srv/shiny-server/ms-app/.Renviron
sudo systemctl restart shiny-server
```
